grammar.0.title: The rooms of a flat
grammar.1.title: Compound words — small words joined into big ones
grammar.1.text: Wohn + Zimmer = Wohnzimmer (living room). Schlaf + Zimmer = Schlafzimmer (bedroom). German makes new words by joining words — and the article of the last part is the article of the whole word: das Zimmer → das Wohnzimmer, die Küche → die Wohnküche.
grammar.2.title: er / sie / es — the pronoun follows the article
grammar.2.intro: To avoid repeating a thing's name, use a pronoun. The pronoun follows the article: der → er, die → sie, das → es.
grammar.2.note: English “it” is always the same; German has three, depending on the gender.
